t: The Titan rechargeable LED Work Light provides powerful, consistent illumination for various professional and domestic tasks. This versatile 3500 lumen work light is ideal for electricians, plumbers, and DIY enthusiasts working on site, in workshops, or tackling home renovation projects, delivering bright 6500K daylight. Its robust IP65 rating ensures reliable performance in dusty or damp conditions both indoors and outdoors. The adjustable head and folding stand allow precise light positioning, while 3-step dimming offers flexible brightness control. Featuring an integrated power bank with a USB-A port, it also conveniently charges mobile devices, making it a highly functional tool for any tradesperson needing dependable portable lighting and on-the-go power. The constant lumen output maintains steady brightness throughout its 12-hour low mode runtime.
